# Project Nina

> Nina is a Christchurch, New Zealand renovator who buys and renovates tired properties: as-is, where-is, TLC, full renovations, tired rentals, vacant homes, deceased estates and subdivision projects. No project too big, too scary or too small.

- Private owners and landlords can contact Nina in confidence to sell as-is or arrange an assisted sale (Nina renovates first so the property sells for more).
- Real estate agents can send Nina hard-to-sell listings; the agent keeps the client relationship, and renovated homes can be relisted with them.
- Area: Christchurch and greater Canterbury.
- Website: https://www.project-nina.co.nz
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nabiulina.nina/
